attempts.summary: Created a LUKS2-encrypted volume (file-backed image at /var/lib/secure-volume/secure.img, keyfile at /etc/luks-keys/secure.key, mode 600) on node1, formatted it XFS, mounted it at /srv/secure, and wired /etc/crypttab + /etc/fstab so it auto-unlocks and mounts at boot via systemd-cryptsetup@secure.service and srv-secure.mount. Verified with a live reboot: boot_id changed from 5fb1b173-c1c8-4647-b118-0145511f0fcc to 9b2d2213-cba2-409e-b416-9a78c3b74a90, and post-reboot the volume was auto-unlocked/mounted with the pre-reboot test file intact and no failed units.
